target.title: fix(agents): keep missing error details out of auth health
target.body:
Related: #100600

AI-assisted: yes. I understand the touched auth-profile failure policy: the change keeps the existing `no_error_details` failover diagnostic available for retry/fallback decisions while preventing that detail-less provider failure from being persisted as shared auth-profile health.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with valid Azure/OpenAI-compatible credentials could have an active auth profile cooled down when an upstream `response.failed` event omitted error details. That detail-less provider failure can then look like a credential/auth problem and contribute to misleading fallback or auth-profile health state.

## Why This Change Was Made

`no_error_details` is a runtime/transport diagnostic, not proof that the shared auth profile is bad. This change treats it like other non-credential transport failures in the embedded runner auth-profile failure policy, without changing the failover reason itself or the existing Responses diagnostic logging.

The change is intentionally narrow: it does not change `auth`, `billing`, `rate_limit`, timeout-after-provider-start, model fallback, or the Responses `response.failed` observation path.

## User Impact

Valid credentials are less likely to enter cooldown solely because a provider returned a failed response without useful error fields. Users should see fewer misleading auth-health cascades for transient detail-less provider failures.

## Evidence

- Runtime proof added in `src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts`: the new e2e case drives a detail-less primary OpenAI failure through `runWithModelFallback` + `runEmbeddedAgent`, verifies fallback to `groq/mock-2`, records `result.attempts[0]?.reason === "no_error_details"`, and verifies `openai:p1` keeps both `cooldownUntil` and `failureCounts.no_error_details` unset while `groq:p1` records `lastUsed`. This uses deterministic mocked provider attempts only; no live credentials, request IDs, account IDs, or private endpoints are included.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts src/agents/model-fallback.run-embedded.e2e.test.ts` passed: 1 file, 21 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner.e2e.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner.run-embedded-agent.auth-profile-rotation.e2e.test.ts` passed: 2 files, 46 tests.
- Before the fix, the new focused regression test failed with `expected 'no_error_details' to be null` in `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts` passed: 1 file, 8 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/failover-policy.test.ts src/agents/model-fallback.probe.test.ts src/agents/auth-profiles/usage.test.ts src/agents/auth-profiles.markauthprofilefailure.test.ts` passed: 6 files, 438 tests.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts` passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-profile-failure-policy.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `codex review --base origin/main` completed with no concrete regression identified in the touched policy or caller paths.
